draft_text: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline significantly outperformed Varrow-NMT in BLEU (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
revised_text: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline achieved a higher mean BLEU than Varrow-NMT (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
rationale: The BLEU means (T1.r1.bleu=28.4, T1.r2.bleu=27.6) support a higher-mean claim. However, the only reported statistical test (S1) is for exp1/cmp2 (Tessaline vs PhraseGrid), not for the Tessaline vs Varrow-NMT comparison. No significance test is reported for this comparison, so "significantly" is unsupported.
